result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days. The fix is a one-line change in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (around line 906): the block was formatting `loc180Days` instead of `loc90Days`, so I switched it to `loc90Days`.

The `reports` module compiles offline. I found no landscape-specific tests in that module, so I did not run any tests. I did not check the rendered report in a browser. Nothing is committed.
